audit.why: EVEN / 5.5-6/10 matches the 53.43% win rate over 2635 games. Karma is a poke-and-utility lane with no all-in; Akshan's difficulty is holding E Heroic Swing as an escape rather than an engage.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text framed Karma's threat as a dodgeable Mantra root and called her Q 'short-range'.
audit.why: Inner Flame (Q) is 950 range and outranges Akshan's 850 Avengerang. Mantra (R) is a 40/38/36/34s charge she accelerates with every damaging ability (Gathering Fire), and the Mantra root is Focused Resolve (W) — a targeted 675-range tether, not a skillshot. Akshan's real spikes: level 3 full kit, level 6 Comeuppance on a 100s cooldown, first item.
audit.corrected: Spikes rewritten around the two-pass boomerang, the 12s flat tether cooldown, and the 100s Comeuppance lock-on.
sources: brief kits (Karma Q 950/cd 9-5, W cd 12 flat, R cd 40/38/36/34; Akshan Q 850, R 100/85/70)

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer inverts Karma's W and E throughout: 'her E root', 'Mantra-E root', 'W speed shield', 'Mantra-W shield'.
audit.why: Karma W is Focused Resolve (the tether/root, 675 range, flat 12s, reveals the target and is buffed by Mantra to heal her and extend the root). Karma E is Inspire (shield + move speed; Mantra-E spreads it to nearby allies). Every slot reference in the content layer is backwards. Additionally the reveal on Focused Resolve is the decisive interaction versus Akshan's W camouflage and was never stated, and the tether is broken by distance or line of sight — which is exactly what Heroic Swing does.
audit.corrected: Slots corrected to W = Focused Resolve (root/reveal), E = Inspire (shield). Reveal-vs-camouflage and break-the-tether-by-distance interactions now stated.
sources: brief enemyKit slots W/E and flags (revealsStealth, hardCC, heal on W; shield on E)

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns named the tether but gave no numbers and omitted Mantra entirely.
audit.why: Focused Resolve is a flat 12s at every rank — a fixed, countable window. Mantra is 40/38/36/34s and Gathering Fire shortens it on every damaging ability, so 'she just used Mantra' is not a fixed 40s of safety.
audit.corrected: Numbers added; Mantra charge behaviour stated.

audit.why: Common Mistakes carries no elo language and the listed errors (standing in a loaded combo, spending the swing on poke, trading without the passive shield) are the real ones.

edits.before: Your poke trades and passive damage beat Karma's short-range Q from level 1
edits.after: Inner Flame outranges you at 950, but her poke loses to your three-hit string

edits.before: Q Avengerang trades favorably into Karma's short-range Q Inner Flame poke, and your E Heroic Swing lets you dodge her Mantra-empowered root before it lands, keeping her chip damage from ever adding up.
edits.after: Q Avengerang double-passes for two hits while Inner Flame lands once, and Heroic Swing breaks Focused Resolve's tether by walking out of range before the root fires, so her chip never adds up.

edits.before: Punish her root (E) cooldown windows with an all-in using P stacks
edits.after: Punish Focused Resolve (W) on its flat 12s cooldown with P stacks

edits.before: Use E root to set up a trade then disengage with W speed shield
edits.after: Root you with Focused Resolve (W), then disengage behind Inspire

edits.before: Roam bot with Mantra-W shield once she has priority
edits.after: Roam bot with Mantra-E shields once she has priority

edits.before: Karma's kit is built around poke and utility, not burst, so trading Q for Q you actually come out ahead thanks to your passive's mark damage on top. Dodge her E root by holding E Heroic Swing until she commits, then punish the recovery with a full trade — she has no way to all-in you back. Keep wave pressure on her; she wants to freeze and roam, and you deny that by shoving early.
edits.after: Karma has no burst, and Inner Flame (Q) trades one hit for your boomerang's two passes plus passive mark damage, so you win Q for Q. Focused Resolve (W) is a 675-range tether on a flat 12-second cooldown: step out of range or behind the wave and the root never fires, then punish the 12 seconds with a full string. Shove early — she wants a freeze and a roam.

edits.before: Once Comeuppance comes online at 6, Karma's habit of roaming with Mantra-shield becomes a liability — if she leaves lane and you notice, you can threaten her or the lane she's ganking from a full map away. In lane itself she still can't punish your E resets or Q poke, since her only answer is more poke, which you win thanks to your passive execute damage stacking every trade. Keep denying her freeze attempts and punish every Mantra-E root miss hard.
edits.after: Once Comeuppance comes online at 6, Karma's Mantra-Inspire roams become a liability — she is a 100-second lock-on away from dying two screens from lane, so watch for her leaving and start storing bullets. In lane her only answer is more Inner Flame, and your boomerang's two passes plus passive marks beat it every trade. Focused Resolve reveals you, so do not open W camouflage inside 675 range of her — walk out of the tether first, then vanish.

edits.before: Karma wins by landing Focused Resolve (Tether), denying your pattern, and keeping the fight at a distance your kit resents.
edits.after: Karma wins by rooting you with Focused Resolve as you swing, then out-ranging you at 950 while Inspire shields the trade back.

edits.before: - Karma Focused Resolve (Tether): matchup-defining — The root tether — break it with range or line of sight. It governs your forward steps. - E Heroic Swing spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Karma Focused Resolve (W): matchup-defining — a flat 12s tether that reveals; break it by range or line of sight before the root lands. - Mantra is a 40s charge she shortens with every damaging spell. - E Heroic Swing spent on poke is a death you scheduled.

notes: The content layer had Karma's W and E slots inverted in five places (early, mid, wants.you[1], wants.foe[1], wants.foe[2]) — W is Focused Resolve (root/reveal), E is Inspire (shield). Karma's Q is 950 range and OUT-ranges Akshan's 850 Q; 'short-range Q' was wrong. Focused Resolve's reveal beats Akshan's W camouflage and had never been stated anywhere on the page — now in mid. missingInteractions flagged needs-antiheal (Mantra-W heals her through chip); I did not add a Grievous Wounds line because no field in scope had a length-neutral slot for it without cutting a verified fact — see sectionsMissing note. Level chart is all-Akshan across seven rows and I left it: 53.43% over 2635 games supports Akshan favoured overall, but Level 1 is arguable given Inner Flame's 950 range and 40 mana cost.
